description: GH-414 measurement A — sustained single-host dashboard work whose host IS a match_term. 180 synthetic Chrome visits to one dashboard host over 8h on 2026-07-13, varying only the query string (the shape reported in #414). Measures what survives collect_chrome's window thinner (chrome_collapse_minutes, default 12). Pair with golden_chrome_dashboard_tracked_only_dataset.json, which changes only where the host is declared.
timezone_note: Eval sets TZ=UTC before importing the report stack so day keys and parsing match CI and local runs.
